# 0.0 Environment Set-up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Loads libraries from LPDB_libraries.R script
source(here::here("03_Scripts/LPDB_libraries.R"))

# Load functions from LPDB_functions.R script
source(here::here("03_Scripts/LPDB_functions.R"))

# Load data keys to crosswalk municipality names to municipal IDs
keys <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> 
  select(c(muni_name,muni_id)) |> 
  mutate(muni_name = stringr::str_to_title(muni_name))

#Global options to remove scientific notation and set random seed
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(351)

# Set Land Use Code Vintage
q <- "Q1"
yr <- "2026"
```

# 1.1 Load MAPC Land Use Code Crosswalk
```{r}
# Load the MAPC Land Use Code Crosswalk
mapc.luc.xwalk <- readRDS(here(paste0("04_Output/Internal/MAPC.LUC_xwalk_.",q,"_",yr,".rds")))
```

# 1.2 Load Complementary Datasets
```{r}
# Load MHP Residensity product Land Use Codes
# File download from
# Create a one digit land use code flag and remove TOWN_ID == 0 (DLS Standard Codes)
mhp.luc.xwalk <- read_xlsx(here("02_Data/Raw/Land Use Codes/MHP/LUTstandards_Residensity.xlsx"), sheet = 1) |>
  mutate(od_uc = str_sub(USE_CODE, start = 1, end = 1)) |> filter(TOWN_ID != 0) |> 
  left_join(keys, c("TOWN_ID" = "muni_id"))
# 
# Load UMDI Land Use Code Crosswalk
# File download from 
umdi.luc.xwalk <- read_xlsx(here("02_Data/Raw/Land Use Codes/UMDI/Standardized LUC Matching Guide_ForDistribution20260428.xlsx"), sheet = 1) |>
  mutate(od_uc = str_sub(USE_CODE, start = 1, end = 1))

```

# 2.2 MHP Land Use Code Crosswalk Comparison
```{r}
# MHP Individual Analysis
# What are the standardized land use descriptions assigned in the crosswalk?
tbl.1 <- mhp.luc.xwalk |> 
  group_by(standardized_LU_Description) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
# Residential and Mixed use Codes. Does not include codes outside of that. Only 40 distinct codes. 
# 21 distinct residential descriptions (compared to 19 from DLS)
# 11 distinct mixed use descriptions (compared to 35 different combinations from DLS)

# What are the "BroadUse Categories assigned to each municipal code?
tbl.2 <- mhp.luc.xwalk |> 
  group_by(BroadUse) |> 
  summarise(
    n= n()
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
# 7 "BroadUse" categories which do not all match to the 10 One digit categories from the DLS data. Consolidation of some into broader categories.

mhp.std <- mhp.luc.xwalk |> filter(!is.na(standardized_LUC))

print(nrow(mhp.std))

mhp.no.std <- mhp.luc.xwalk |> filter(is.na(standardized_LUC))

print(nrow(mhp.no.std))

# MHP seems to have created two levels of crosswalking.
# 1) "BroadUse" what I would refer to as the "One-Digit Use Code Category" - 6,553 municipal-specific use codes
# 2) Three digit standardized use codes - 2,385 municipal specific use codes

# Observations
# - Mixed use codes receive a fourth digit suffix "M". I went about operationalizing the text of the DLS Code book - first digit zero, second and third digits representing the two major property classifications (third digit being zero if no other information is provided), and allocating the "_underlying" code to a separate variable to maintain specificity.
# - Unsure what vintage is.
# - Don't address mixed use codes in non-mixed use group + residential.
# - Unclear how consistent the mixed use assignment is/the processes. Instances where 013 is assigned to a parcel that explicitly states its a 037 (comm + ag) (code 137 in town 189)

# MHP Comparison Analysis
mhp.comp <- full_join(
  mapc.luc.xwalk,
  mhp.luc.xwalk,
  by = c("muni_name", "MUNI.USE_CODE" = "USE_CODE")
) |> 
  mutate(
    std.luc_compare = if_else(STD.USE_CODE == standardized_LUC, TRUE, FALSE)
  )

# Dataframe of land use codes not present in MHP Crosswalk.
not.present.mhp <- mhp.comp |> filter(is.na(TOWN_ID))

print(nrow(not.present.mhp))
# 1,611 land use codes present in the Q1 2026 MassGIS Property Tax Parcel file are not present in the MHP crosswalk.

#
not.present.mapc <- mhp.comp |> 

# 
std.comp_tbl <- mhp.comp |> 
  group_by(std.luc_compare) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

f_std.luc_compare <- mhp.comp |> filter(std.luc_compare == FALSE)
t_std.luc_compare <- mhp.comp |> filter(std.luc_compare == TRUE)

```
